newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end choppy day higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end choppy day higher.

text.p: U.S. stock index futures closed higher and in the upper portion of daily ranges after another choppy session.
Ranges were a little bit smaller than the volatile session Friday, when prices traversed a 10-point range twice in the final half-hour of the session.
Volume also remained lighter than usual, making for thin trading conditions and adding to the volatile price movements and a hesitancy to hold on to positions, traders said.
Strength in the bond market contributed to the advance, traders said.

The bond market firmed after the January National Association of Purchasing Management index declined more than anticipated. Technical buying fueled the advance in the bond market, which in turn prompted local short-covering in index futures, traders said.
Buy-stops were also activated in March S&P 500s above 789.50, which also contributed to the advance. Further resistance near 792.50 remained intact, however.
Nikkei 225 stock index futures posted small gains, recovering late in the session from losses incurred earlier after weakness in the spot index overnight.

At settlement, March S&P 500s were up 2.25 points at 789.75, NASDAQ 100s eased 2.50 to 924.00, Russell 2000s fell 0.25 point to 370.00, Value Line futures were up 3.35 point to 708.80, Nikkei 225 index futures gained 20.0 to 18,340.0 and Midcap 400s advanced 0.25 point to 266.05 ((--Derivatives Desk: 312-408-8750)) ((email:derivatives@reuters.com))
